name: WebBrowserInstance
label: Web Browser Instance
description: Enter or choose the variable that contains the web browser instance to work with.

name: UiElement
label: UI Element
description: The selector used to locate the link or button on the web page.

name: FindType
label: Find Type
description: Specifies how to find the element (e.g., ID, XPath, CssSelector).

name: ClickType
label: Click Type
description: Specifies the type of click to perform.

selectOptions.label: Left Click
selectOptions.description: Standard left mouse click.

selectOptions.label: Right Click
selectOptions.description: Right mouse click.

selectOptions.label: Double Click
selectOptions.description: Double-click with the left mouse button.

selectOptions.label: Left Button Down
selectOptions.description: Mouse left button down only.

selectOptions.label: Left Button Up
selectOptions.description: Mouse left button up only.

selectOptions.label: Right Button Down
selectOptions.description: Mouse right button down only.

selectOptions.label: Right Button Up
selectOptions.description: Mouse right button up only.

selectOptions.label: Middle Click
selectOptions.description: Middle mouse button click.

name: SendPhysicalClick
label: Send Physical Click
description: If true, simulates physical mouse movement before clicking.

name: WaitForPageLoad
label: Wait for Page Load
description: If true, waits for the next page to load after the click.

name: TimeoutForPageLoad
label: Timeout for Page Load
description: The maximum time (in seconds) to wait for the page to load.

name: IfDialogAppears
label: Handle Dialog
description: Specifies what to do if a dialog appears after the click.

selectOptions.label: Close It
selectOptions.description: Automatically close any pop-up dialog that appears.

selectOptions.label: Press a Button
selectOptions.description: Press a specified button on the dialog.

selectOptions.label: Do Nothing
selectOptions.description: Ignore any pop-up dialog.

selectOptions.label: Close It / Press a Button
selectOptions.description: Close or press a button on the dialog.

name: DialogButtonToPress
label: Dialog Button to Press
description: The name of the button to press if a dialog appears (e.g., 'Ok', 'Cancel').

name: MousePosition
label: Mouse Position Relative to Element
description: Specifies where to position the mouse relative to the element before clicking.

selectOptions.label: Top Left
selectOptions.description: Positions the mouse at the top-left of the element.

selectOptions.label: Middle Left
selectOptions.description: Positions the mouse at the middle-left of the element.

selectOptions.label: Bottom Left
selectOptions.description: Positions the mouse at the bottom-left of the element.

selectOptions.label: Top Center
selectOptions.description: Positions the mouse at the top-center of the element.

selectOptions.label: Middle Center
selectOptions.description: Positions the mouse in the center of the element.

selectOptions.label: Bottom Center
selectOptions.description: Positions the mouse at the bottom-center of the element.

selectOptions.label: Top Right
selectOptions.description: Positions the mouse at the top-right of the element.

selectOptions.label: Middle Right
selectOptions.description: Positions the mouse at the middle-right of the element.

selectOptions.label: Bottom Right
selectOptions.description: Positions the mouse at the bottom-right of the element.

name: OffsetX
label: Offset X
description: Move the mouse this many pixels horizontally from the selected position.

name: OffsetY
label: Offset Y
description: Move the mouse this many pixels vertically from the selected position.
